column1: # Talk to an *ordinary* town resident - one whose dialogue byte is a
# `.TLK` blob id rather than a shop trigger or the reserved guard index - so the
# comparison is of the plain conversation path with none of the adjacency
# dispatch u5-spec#215 and u5-spec#216 are about.
# This replaces a seeded version that could never compare anything twice over:
# its recorded seed directory had never been written to, so both sides sat on
# the title menu, and even with a real seed a town Talk cannot be compared from
# an engine-written save (`saved-gam.md` Section 12's NPC band, see the README).
# Walking in through the door rebuilds the roster from the `.NPC` file on both
# sides, which is what makes the stock side answer at all.
# Britain at 10:00, target dialog-id 9. Route from
# `talk_gate_probe --script e --chase 9`, which re-plans after every step. NPC
# schedules drift, so expect to run this more than once before it lands - a run
# that reaches empty floor has measured nothing.
# requires-seed: the party outside Britain on the overworld at 10:00, so the scenario can walk in through the door
